rationale: Keep the full nonempty domain since all values divide M=N=K=2048, so every tuple is feasible and genuine MIP selection remains meaningful. Retain shared_memory_limit=49152 (conservative dev cap); required schema fixes threads=[128]. Feedback shows selected 128x128x64,1-stage compiled at sm_121a with 188 regs, 32768 dynamic smem, 2 blocks/SM, and simulator ~271us over 3 waves with dominant tensor activity and modest DRAM. That supports traffic-heavy weighting; slightly raise pipeline and footprint weights to discourage high-stage/low-K variants that raise smem pressure and modeled occupancy loss beyond the observed 2-blocks/SM regime, while keeping launches moderate. No domain pruning is justified since MIP over the small candidate set is cheap and feasibility holds. Caveat: simulator/compile resource values and CPU-shadow passing do NOT establish CUDA correctness or GB10 performance; no SASS-derived timing claims are made beyond the provided model estimate, and no GPU-checked results are claimed.
